title: A small system, end to end
summary: Deploy an event-driven product-manual assistant. Follow uploads, indexing, questions and answers through the whole system.

title: Check your starting point
summary: Use one Bash environment and catch permissions, quota and model-access blockers early.

title: Start the Azure resources
summary: Prove model access, create the shared network, then start AKS and PostgreSQL while you work on Docker.

title: Read, build and run Products
summary: Understand the supplied Spring Boot application and turn its source into a versioned container image.

title: Connect data, settings and identity
summary: Configure private PostgreSQL, Flyway, private blobs, Key Vault secrets and App Configuration settings.

title: Deploy Products to AKS
summary: Read a Deployment, Pod and Service; then open a restricted HTTPS endpoint and inspect its rollout.

title: Turn a manual into vectors
summary: Deploy a Python Function whose Event Grid-backed Blob trigger chunks and indexes an immutable manual safely.

title: Ask a grounded question
summary: Follow a persistent question through Service Bus, vector retrieval, the model and a correlated reply.

title: Make the queue drive scaling
summary: Observe zero workers, a bounded backlog, multiple workers, completed answers and a return to zero.

title: Verify, diagnose and clean up
summary: Run the real-deployment smoke test, diagnose failures and deliberately remove only workshop resources.
